subject: 🏃 Sunday — Cycling 75 min easy or Hike 90 min
html:
Today's workout: Cross-train — cycling 75 min easy OR hike 90 min. This is the cap on Chassis Build Week 2. Keep it genuinely easy — HR under 130, conversational effort the whole time. Sawyer Camp or Rancho for the hike; bike trainer or flat Bayfront loop for cycling.

Focus cue: This is a recovery-tempo day. If you hike, enjoy it. If you bike, stay seated and spin easy. No intensity.

Flag — I need your knee feedback. Strava auto-logged two runs this week with pending knee status: Apr 29 (5.79 mi, 8:13/mi, HR 148) and May 1 (5.08 mi, 7:45/mi, HR 152). Both were faster and harder than the Chassis Build plan allows — the Apr 29 run also blew past the 5 mi cap. I can't assess whether to modify the plan without knowing how the knee responded. Send me a quick Green/Yellow/Red for each when you get a chance.

Honest note on pace: Those two runs averaged 8:13 and 7:45 with heart rates in the high 140s–150s. During Chassis Build, every run should be easy — HR under 140, pace 9:00+/mi. The aerobic fitness is clearly there, but the whole point of this phase is protecting the knee while we rebuild the chassis underneath it. Running hard right now is borrowing against the exact joint we're trying to fix.

Context: Week 2 of 4 in Chassis Build — 12 days to your PT follow-up on May 15. The chassis work is the investment that makes the 10-week marathon build possible. Tomorrow starts Week 3, where we add light dumbbells to Hip & Core if the knee has stayed green.
